product_metadata.title: Queen Mary 3 Piece Bathroom Rug Set, Luxury Soft Plush Shaggy Thick Fluffy Microfiber Bath Mat, Countour Rug, Toilet Seat Lid Cover, Non-Slip Rubber Back, Floor Mats Water Absorbent - Turquoise
features: Luxury 3 piece bathroom rug set "Queen Mary" that protects bathroom floor, keeps your feet dry, and adds luxury to your bathroom
Soft non-skid rubber backing adds strong powerful gripping and prevents slippage
Made of fluffy soft thick dense Microfiber Polyester pile, great water absorbing mats
Adds a decorative look with a variety of solid color options, easy to match any bathrooms
Package includes: (1) 18x30 Inch Bath Mat, (1) 18x18 Inch Contour Rug, (1) Standard Size Universal Lid Cover (measured approximately 14x16 Inch, does not fit elongated seat)
description: Step on this luxury soft Queen Mary 3-piece rug set by Kashi Home and enjoy its softness. Queen Mary rug set is made of well-constructedsoft, high quality thick & fluffy microfiber material. Providing softness to your feet after showering and adding a touch of luxury to your bathroom. 3 Piece set includes (1) 18x30 Inch Bath Mat, (1) 18x18 Inch Contour Rug, and (1) Standard Size Universal Lid Cover (measured approximately 14x16 Inch, does not fit elongated seat). These mats feature non-slip 100% rubber back. Soft and thickhigh microfiber pile - 100% Polyester. Great absorbent and very soft to step on. Easy care: Machine wash cold. Do not bleach. Do not tumbledry or dry clean. The package includes 3 pieces: (1) an 18x30 Inch Bath Mat, (1) 18x18 Inch Contour Rug, and (1) Standard Size Universal Lid Cover. Available colors: Black, Burgundy, Grey, Chocolate, Mocha, Navy, Olive, Orange, Turquoise, White, Red, Fuchsia, Yellow.
